title: Compose and publish Mushroom Jazz variation: Amber Soul
description: Compose and publish a completely different genre variation: warm downtempo Mushroom Jazz / trip-hop score built around Emerge loop-2 and AlexBeroza vocal cuts over a swung 92 BPM late-night lounge pocket.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Composed and measured Mushroom Jazz: Amber Soul (92 BPM, Am) with rich jazz chord movement (Am7 -> Fmaj7 -> Dm7 -> Em7). Features relaxed 58% 8th-note swing, delicate rim clicks and ghost notes, warm electric piano / lounge guitar from Emerge loop-2, walking sub bass notes, and dub-delay vocal echoes from Ave phrase-3/phrase-6. Measured objective_v2 102.79 (Q_mean 0.83). Published to cloud storage as scr_scores_Mushroom Jazz: Amber Soul_apr.

right_now_summary: Amber Soul is composed, measured, and published as a warm 92 BPM Mushroom Jazz score.
